title: Consequential Behaviour and Representational Fairness in the Validation of Synthetic Research

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes a validation framework that measures synthetic respondents' predictive accuracy and variance against human benchmark data across predefined demographic and socioeconomic strata, specifically evaluating the "intention-behaviour gap" and diagnostic levels like distribution dispersion, response process, and structural fidelity to detect subgroup flattening and representation failure.
